turns.text: Hello, I want to return a print and get the money back. I ordered the wrong size.
Hello! I can help with that. Please send me the order number (like SC-1234) and the email the order was placed with, so I can verify it.
The order is SC-3744 and the email is claire.fontaine@example.com.

Thank you, Claire, your order is verified. Because of the refund amount, I can't file this return myself. A member of staff has to decide. I've passed your request to a colleague, who will take over. For reference, the shop rule says catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage, and staff must approve the refund.

rule.ro: Printurile din catalog se pot returna în 14 zile de la livrare. Clientul plătește transportul retur. Rambursarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: Catalogue prints can be returned within 14 days of delivery. The customer pays the return postage. Staff must approve the refund.

input.summary: Verified customer Claire Fontaine (claire.fontaine@example.com) wants to return order SC-3744 (Last Lantern, limited, 40x50 cm, 1350 RON, delivered 2026-11-09) for a refund because she ordered the wrong size. Policy check flags large_refund, so a person must decide.
